steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Physical skills are the foundation of all dance performance and underpin technical and expressive work

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Flexibility is the range of movement at a joint and allows dancers to achieve extended lines and shapes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Strength is the ability of muscles to exert force and is needed for lifts, jumps and controlled movements

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Stamina (cardiovascular endurance) enables dancers to sustain energy throughout an entire performance

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Name the five physical skills a dancer needs for performance. | Q: Why is flexibility important for a dancer? | Q: How does stamina affect dance performance quality?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Flexibility, strength, stamina, coordination and balance. | Flexibility increases the range of movement at joints, allowing dancers to create extended lines, achieve required shapes and reduce the risk of injury. | Stamina allows the dancer to maintain energy, technique and expression throughout the entire performance without deterioration.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Use the terms flexibility, strength, stamina, coordination and balance precisely — do not confuse them in written answers When describing a performer's physical skills, always link the skill to the effect on the audience or the quality of the dance Remember that stamina is about sustaining the whole performance, not just being fit in general In 6-mark questions, aim to cover at least three physical skills with clear explanations and dance examples Physical skills are often assessed alongside technical and expressive skills — show how they connect
